prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal Trail, Kaski, Nepal, under a night sky. The camera advances through a narrow path bordered by dense trees and rocky outcrops, their silhouettes faintly illuminated by the dim ambient light. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle remains at eye level, capturing the texture of the snow-laden ground and the occasional patches of exposed earth. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, with only the faint glow of moonlight filtering through the branches, casting long shadows across the trail. The camera continues its steady advance, navigating slight bends and inclines, revealing a metal railing on the right side that guides the path upwards. The snowy landscape appears untouched, with no signs of other travelers, emphasizing the solitude of the journey. The atmosphere is quiet and serene, with the soft crunch of snow underfoot being the only audible sound. As the camera moves further, the trail becomes slightly steeper, and the railing becomes more prominent, indicating an ascent into higher terrain. The overall scene maintains a consistent, tranquil ambiance, with the interplay of shadow and light creating a visually captivating experience.
